# Weft 1.0.17
- Honor Node, pnpm, npm, yarn, and bun string pins in the root mise.toml and .mise.toml files when no existing declaration takes precedence. Recheck installation state when either mise file changes. - Preserve the default Node version for projects without a pin. Projects pinned to Node 26 through mise now replace an incompatible installed Node version on their next start. - Fix a test listener cleanup hang by bounding shutdown and signaling the helper process directly.
